description: RemodelerIQ helps homeowners avoid overpaying on renovations. Describe or paste a contractor's bid and RemodelerIQ scores it 0–100 for fairness and risk, then flags problems like oversized deposits, vague scope, and missing permits or payment schedules. Every number is grounded in real data — BLS trade wages, Zonda Cost vs. Value benchmarks, and regional cost adjustments across 152 U.S. metros. You can also ask what a kitchen, bath, roof, or addition should cost in your state, or what fair trade labor rates are. Free, no signup, read-only.
